instruction: Navigate to the Apple Human Interface Guidelines page about searching.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to Apple HIG searching page, scrolled to understand content structure, opened terminal, used curl to download HTML, installed python-docx and beautifulsoup4, wrote a Python script to extract content between 'Searching' and 'Resources' sections, created notes.docx on Desktop. File was created (36KB) but content/formatting did not match the gold standard docx.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome to specific URLs, scroll web pages, open terminal, use curl to download files, install pip packages, write and execute Python scripts, create files on Desktop
metadata.failure_analysis: Model successfully created a docx file but the content extraction via regex and plain-text formatting did not match the gold standard document. The compare_docx_files evaluator found the documents too different despite fuzzy matching.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to just the URL navigation step, which the model demonstrated successfully in the trajectory
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating Chrome to the Apple HIG searching page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the expected pattern using is_expected_url_pattern_match.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL as a string
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly receives the rules dict and accesses rules['expected'] for regex patterns
Regex pattern 'developer\.apple\.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching' correctly identifies the Apple HIG searching page URL
Single-step instruction (navigate to URL) is fully covered by single URL pattern verification
No postconfig needed since the active tab URL state persists after navigation
